items.title: Google Cloud sends agent telemetry to BigQuery for governance
problems: The item says custom-agent transcripts can be sent to BigQuery. | The sources describe custom-agent traces and telemetry, but only describe transcript logging for first-party conversational analytics agents.

The item says teams previously had no shared BigQuery path for first-party and custom-agent telemetry, logs, and evaluation results. | The sources announce the new framework but do not establish that teams previously lacked such a path.

items.title: GitHub retires six Copilot models on 14 December
problems: The item says all six models will be retired without exception. | The source exempts Claude Haiku 4.5 for individual subscribers on annual plans.

The item presents automatic enablement of replacement models as universal. | The source limits automatic enablement to Enterprise and Business customers and notes that admins can turn off the global default or disable a model.
